fields.label: Trigger Episode
fields.description: The shift is in effect starting at this episode number (inclusive) for every subsequent episode in the run.

fields.label: Hidden From Agents
fields.description: When checked (the default, and the only mode implemented so far), the shift changes environmental parameters only -- agents are never told a shift occurred, per spec section 2.4.

fields.label: Parameter Delta (JSON)
fields.description: Currently only the 'qty_multiplier' key is read by the scenario generator (spec section 11's demand_distribution, concretely a demand shock). Other parameter deltas (supplier reliability reversal, exception-family changes, etc.) arrive with the full Scenario Studio generator.
